title: The botanical diving bell
alt: A copper and glass diving bell shelters a luminous underwater greenhouse.
description: A submarine greenhouse, with connected pressure-vessel details and planted walkways.
prompt: An intricate science-fiction diving bell resting on a dark rocky seafloor, seen through clear teal water. A large rounded copper-and-glass pressure vessel contains a lush miniature greenhouse with visible plants, lights and walkways. Thick metal ribs support the glass windows; a sealed circular hatch and heavy legs connect to the body. Thin air bubbles rise from a small external vent, underwater light rays and scattered sand create depth. Complete vehicle visible, believable mechanical structure, no people or text.
